name: Brail
description: An upright leech with the brailing line hauled across it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 44%; width: 12%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2%; right: 2%; top: 58%; height: 8%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(-18deg); transform: rotate(-18deg); opacity: 0.8; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
